title: Beyond Three Terms: Exponential Bounds in the Neumann Heat Trace of Polygons
summary: We study the short-time asymptotic behavior of the heat trace associated with the Neumann Laplacian on polygonal domains in the plane. By establishing locality principles for the heat kernel near corners, edges, and the interior, we approximate the heat kernel on the polygon by model heat kernels defined on infinite sectors, half-planes, and the full plane, respectively. Although it is known that the Neumann heat trace of polygons admits a three-term asymptotic expansion followed by an exponentially small remainder, an explicit estimate for the exponent in this remainder term is not known.…
